reasons.correctness: getTicketStats is admin-gated with the same InsufficientPermissionsException key as updateTicketStatus. It rejects from>to with error.validation.invalid_date_range and fills an EnumMap for every status. Bounds are atStartOfDay and plusDays(1). Hidden tests pass 5/5.
reasons.convention_fit: The endpoint has @PreAuthorize ADMIN and @RateLimit and returns TicketStatsDtoOut from the feature dtos package. The error is a ValidationTranslatableException, with the new key in both messages_en and messages_pl. There is no field injection and no schema change.
reasons.design_fit: The permission and date-range checks live in the service and the count query is a derived repository method. The controller only delegates. It reuses the existing admin-check pattern and the exception hierarchy. The footprint is minimal.
reasons.test_quality: SupportTicketServiceTicketStatsUnitTest covers per-status counts and total, all zeros with from==to, the inverted range and non-admin denial, asserting message keys and no repository calls. The controller test covers delegation and missing auth. MockitoExtension, no Spring context.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries mapped the support/ticket package, TESTED_BY tests and dependents of the controller, service and repository before any read or edit. The agent then read those exact files and the existing unit tests and followed them.
